neighbours.label: A space directly followed by a character the tokenizer splits into raw byte pieces (uncommon emoji and symbols, chess pieces, katakana, Korean syllables, polytonic Greek), and the long mark ー before a split katakana; weaker inside fully vowel-marked Arabic or Hebrew. Quiet when the same character is glued to a word, at text start, and for characters kept as whole tokens (€, →, hiragana, everyday Chinese, Cyrillic, unmarked Arabic, accented Latin).
